tasks.label: Run Cabana
tasks.command: ARG="${input:cabanaArg}" && if [ "$ARG" = "live" ]; then UV_CACHE_DIR=/private/tmp/openpilot-uv-cache uv run openpilot/tools/cabana/cabana --zmq tcp://192.168.1.200; else UV_CACHE_DIR=/private/tmp/openpilot-uv-cache uv run openpilot/tools/cabana/cabana "$ARG"; fi

tasks.label: Publish and Deploy ody-op
tasks.command: cd /Users/travisbadgley/openpilot && CURRENT_BRANCH=ody-op && test "$(git branch --show-current)" = "$CURRENT_BRANCH" || { echo "Refusing to deploy: checkout $CURRENT_BRANCH in openpilot first."; exit 1; } && test -z "$(git status --porcelain)" || { echo 'Refusing to deploy: openpilot has uncommitted changes.'; git status --short; exit 1; } && test -z "$(git -C opendbc_repo status --porcelain)" || { echo 'Refusing to deploy: opendbc_repo has uncommitted changes.'; git -C opendbc_repo status --short; exit 1; } && test "$(git -C opendbc_repo branch --show-current)" = "$CURRENT_BRANCH" || { echo 'Refusing to deploy: parent and opendbc_repo branches differ.'; exit 1; } && test "$(git ls-tree HEAD opendbc_repo | awk '{print $3}')" = "$(git -C opendbc_repo rev-parse HEAD)" || { echo 'Refusing to deploy: parent opendbc pin does not match the checked-out submodule.'; exit 1; } && git diff --check && git -C opendbc_repo diff --check && .venv/bin/python .agents/preflash.py && git -C opendbc_repo push origin "$CURRENT_BRANCH" && git push origin "$CURRENT_BRANCH" && ssh -o BatchMode=yes -i /Users/travisbadgley/.ssh/id_ed25519 comma@192.168.1.200 "bash -l -c \"cd /data/openpilot && (git remote set-url origin https://github.com/brikowski/openpilot.git || git remote add origin https://github.com/brikowski/openpilot.git) && tools/op.sh switch origin $CURRENT_BRANCH && tools/op.sh build && (sudo reboot &) && exit 0\""

tasks.label: Run Odyssey software checks
tasks.command: UV_CACHE_DIR=/private/tmp/openpilot-uv-cache lefthook run pre-commit && UV_CACHE_DIR=/private/tmp/openpilot-uv-cache uv run python -m pytest .agents/test_odyssey_long_rails.py .agents/test_sync_upstream.py -q && UV_CACHE_DIR=/private/tmp/openpilot-uv-cache opendbc_repo/test.sh
